Definition: good (as a noun), in the widest sense, especially goodness (superlative concretely, the best), beauty, gladness, welfare
BiblicalUsage: The word ṭûwb carries the sense of goodness, good. In Genesis 24:10, all the goods of his master were in his hand. That is the sense it carries through all 31 of its occurrences.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that the goodness of God is not a vague feeling; it is the plenty He gives, and I have tasted it. That is why I read the passages around ṭûwb slowly, instead of hurrying past.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
